findings.claim: SEAM RESPECTED: W3-KIND does NOT edit moneta_store.py. W3-STORE (my dep) holds an OPEN bus claim on it (building typed cortex write(kind,id)->/MonetaMemory/{kind}/{id} + dual-write add). Posted a block + released moneta_store.py from my claim; routed kind filtering through the backend-agnostic store.get_by_type / MemoryQuery.memory_types API instead.

Adversarial verification (6-lens workflow) found ONE real regression and it was fixed in-scope: enriching the recall payload with type+fields tripped the pre-existing W1 SEAM-C tripwire test_recall_returns_prose_not_a_network (pins recall match == exactly {id,summary,content,date}). Reverted recall to prose-only (kind-filter ROUTING unaffected); the structured typed-field view lives on synapse_search's 'fields' key instead. Tripwire green, W1 test untouched.

Negative control (crucible criterion 3) implemented and proven: kind_schema.resolve_kinds splits requested kinds into valid/invalid; an all-invalid filter returns empty + error + invalid_kinds and is structurally proven never to scan (CountingDict getitem==0, values==0). A partial-invalid filter keeps the valid kinds and reports the rest. Direct store/SynapseMemory API on a bad kind fails LOUD (ValueError/AttributeError), never a silent scan.

Recommend W3-STORE add the moneta by_type non-scan as part of its cortex leg.
